name: Lee's Connection Circle
location: Various member venues, Woodland Hills / Tarzana
description: Long-running Tuesday-morning circle for cross-vertical referrals. Limited to one business per category.

name: Dynamic Business Networking (DBN)
description: Larger Monday lunch group with rotating speakers and structured 30-second commercials.

name: Young Professionals Network
description: Under-40 professionals across the West Valley. Casual mixer format with optional monthly skill workshops.

name: Wellness Resource Network
description: Healthcare, mental wellness, fitness, and integrative-medicine professionals. Cross-referral pipeline + quarterly community wellness fairs.

name: Home Improvement Professionals Network
description: Contractors, plumbers, electricians, roofers, designers, real estate agents — referral-first group with strict reciprocation rules.

name: Chamber Ambassadors
description: 12–15 hours per year minimum. The face of the Chamber — greeting new members, ribbon cuttings, mixers. Not a referral group; a service group with high visibility benefits.

name: AI for Business Circle (NEW)
description: New for 2026 — peer learning on AI tools that move the needle for small Valley businesses. Hands-on, no fluff.

name: Valley Women in Business
description: Women-owned and women-led businesses across the Valley. Mentorship, deals, and a quarterly speaker series.
